top_signals.title: India's Crude Oil Import Bill Soars 46% as Middle East Crisis Drives Up Prices
top_signals.summary: India paid $15.4 billion to import crude oil in September, up by 46% from the year-ago import bill of $10.5 billion, as international oil prices and the Indian import crude basket soared amid reignited tensions in the Middle East. India, the world’s third-largest crude oil importer, saw its crude imports rise by 7% in September from a year earlier. alerts.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
alerts.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructure. Hurricane Isaias is the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season and will be the largest storm system to make landfall in the region since Hurricane Helene in September 2024.
